subject.title: fix: tighten findSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer with execution guard

question: Should the session find tool reject fractional `limit` arguments at schema validation and direct execution, rather than continue its existing normalization behavior?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and preserves zero/negative normalization, but accepting or rejecting a previously accepted model-facing argument is an intentional compatibility contract decision.

options.title: Accept integer-only limit contract
options.body: Approve fractional limits as invalid semantic input and merge after the branch is refreshed against current `main`.

options.title: Preserve fractional normalization
options.body: Keep the existing numeric contract and close this PR if fractional values remain intentionally supported.

recommendation.title: Accept integer-only limit contract
recommendation.body: Approve fractional limits as invalid semantic input and merge after the branch is refreshed against current `main`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their cited prior work provides the closest adjacent precedent for integer-only agent-tool schema contracts.
